testimonial: After a decade involved with ServiceSpace, I still value the phone-free Awakin Circles I attended on both coasts and in Houston: meditation, an hour of sharing, and a meal. Austin’s many newcomers could make something similar flourish here.
title: AI Ethics
intro: These stories connect human connection and community access to the choices we make about AI.

items.title: IRL.group: a home for local creators
items.description: IRL.group gives city and community creators a place to bring people together offline.

items.title: ServiceSpace and Awakin Circles
items.description: Nipun Mehta founded ServiceSpace in the Bay Area. Its free circles welcome friends, family, and strangers with no commercial, denominational, or sponsor agenda.

items.title: The IRL economy is taking off
items.description: The live-event economy is growing as people seek face-to-face connection in an increasingly digital world.

items.title: Scottie Scheffler on choosing the right partnerships
items.description: “It’s not necessarily not wanting to do things. It’s just wanting to do things with the right people.”

items.title: What you’ll find here
items.description: I’ll favor recurring, mindful gatherings over transactional one-offs so people can keep showing up for their local community.

items.title: Faith leaders and AI guardrails
items.description: At an AI conference, faith leaders questioned what AI could cost humanity and whether guardrails can help while its longer-term dangers remain unclear.
